name: grade-scale
title: Grade scale
description: A letter-grade scale such as an energy class or eco score: the whole range drawn, steps that differ in length, the product's grade enlarged.
docs: grades runs from the best grade to the worst, so the first step is the shortest bar and the last the longest. value must be one of them: anything else draws the scale without a marker and the sentence says the product is not graded. label names what is graded and starts the sentence a screen reader hears. It draws a scale, not an official label: bring certified data to it.
